body.name: L_n^\star
body.construction: \[L_n^\star(\kappa_n)=\inf_{I_n}\sup_{P\in\mathcal P_n}E_P[|I_n(O_1,\ldots,O_n)|],\qquad \inf_{P\in\mathcal P_n}P\{\theta_P\in I_n(O_1,\ldots,O_n)\}\ge1-\alpha,\] where the infimum ranges over measurable rules whose values are connected subsets of \(\Theta\).
